summary: UDR, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized a 25 million share increase to its existing buyback program, making total authorization ~30 million shares (over $1 billion at current prices). Repurchases may occur via open-market, block, or private deals with no expiration date. The filing is a straightforward capital return announcement; board recommendation is implicit given the authorization. No advisor was named. The existing January 2008 program is unchanged. The filing does not involve a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review. What to watch: pace of execution and any impact on share price and capital allocation strategy.
